rows:
# vgi-ecb

Discover European Central Bank statistical series and retrieve observations with original periods, units and source metadata. The upstream public data service needs no API key. SQL NULL arguments are rejected; missing source values become NULL. Use function arguments for source filtering; SQL WHERE filters are local. HTTP worker access can require a bearer token.

Queries use bounded HTTP responses and retries. Credentials stay out of continuation state. See README.md for deployment and operational limits.

rows.vgi.agent_test_tasks: [{"name": "datasets", "prompt": "Using ecb.main.datasets, discover ecb datasets. Use the arguments in this example and return the same columns: SELECT flow, name FROM ecb.main.datasets(flow := 'EXR') ORDER BY flow"}, {"name": "dimensions", "prompt": "Using ecb.main.dimensions, discover ecb dimensions. Use the arguments in this example and return the same columns: SELECT dimension, position, codelist FROM ecb.main.dimensions('EXR') ORDER BY position NULLS LAST, dimension"}, {"name": "codes", "prompt": "Using ecb.main.codes, discover ecb dimension codes. Use the arguments in this example and return the same columns: SELECT code, name FROM ecb.main.codes('CL_CURRENCY') WHERE code IN ('USD','EUR') ORDER BY code"}, {"name": "series", "prompt": "Using ecb.main.series, inspect ecb series. Use the arguments in this example and return the same columns: SELECT series_key, title, unit FROM ecb.main.series('EXR', 'D.USD.EUR.SP00.A') ORDER BY series_key"}, {"name": "observations", "prompt": "Using ecb.main.observations, read ecb observations. Use the arguments in this example and return the same columns: SELECT period, value, unit FROM ecb.main.observations('EXR', 'D.USD.EUR.SP00.A', start_period := '2024-01-02', end_period := '2024-01-05') ORDER BY period"}]
